name: Awwwards MCP
pitch: MCP server for design inspiration from award-winning sites: search with real screenshots, extract design and motion DNA, and score your build against a reference.
holdingBack: One month old with a single maintainer, and it depends on scraping awwwards.com, so a site change or a terms objection could break it.
promoteIf: Stays maintained through early 2027 with more contributors and no terms issues.

name: Brag
pitch: Agent skill that turns the project you just built into a short launch video with music, motion and share copy.
holdingBack: Became very popular within four months. The full mode depends on HeyGen's Hyperframes. We're waiting to see whether quality and maintenance last after the launch hype.
promoteIf: Still actively maintained in 2027, with the slim mode (no Hyperframes) proving reliable.
